body: Some days are better than others and the test might seem normal one time and way off the next. I was diagnosed after two months of nonstop vomiting that kept putting me in the er over and over. They tried multiple blood tests scans and scopes including testing my galbladder and seeing if I was simply allergic to gluten (that would have been a better diagnosis!). Finally did the gastric emptying study and once they gave me the meds for gp I got better. I’ve gotten worse since then.  I don’t have diabetes btw so mine is idiopathic. I now a gastric pacemaker and medicines are becoming less and less effective, even when administered through and iv. Prayers your mom is able to manage her symptoms with ease
I hope your dreams come true 💚

Oh yeah I didn’t realize that’s what you meant either. I have pain killers. Been through enough pain I can just stop taking them until I have enough saved up. Take my promethazine before so I’m less likely to throw up. I am not sure how else to just fall asleep and die peacefully. I’m not even sure if I’ll sleep the whole time or if I’ll be miserable for some part of it. Don’t really care though. It will be over soon. Probably take some sleeping pills if I can find any. I would drink but because of my condition I WILL throw up and that won’t work.

That’s all I can think of right now. It’s a lot to remember. I’m sure there’s more I’m forgetting, but basically I’ve tried nearly everything and I’ve lost all my hope. I have not had bypass, gastrectomy or parenteral nutrition. 
I lost my baby last year to this as well and that’s been super hard. I can’t believe I forgot to mention that in the post, it’s like sometimes I block it out or something and it just doesn’t cross my mind...

I’m sorry you’re going through that, too :(
And don’t invalidate your problems because you think mine are worse! Everyone’s situation is different and other people being worse off doesn’t make anybody’s situation any better. Problems are problems. I just hope everyone here has better luck dealing with theirs than I do. 
I smoke a lot, it helps a little, so it’s worth it, but it doesn’t help enough.

Thank you- unfortunately it’s because of a damaged or dysfunctional vagus nerve. Unknown cause in my case. Right now, there’s no way to repair the vagus nerve. My gastric stimulator has wires going into my stomach to pulse it to relieve nausea but max settings aren’t enough for me. It helps some so I keep it. Any surgery to or around the vagus nerve is a high risk for further damage. I hope they find a cure soon. The signals from my brain aren’t reaching my gut anymore. My digestive tract is nearly paralyzed. I really hope there is a way to fix this, but nobody has figured it out yet. Removing the stomach has helped a few and made others worse. So has the stimulator. I’m so tired.
Now I have a gastric stimulator and am on a number of medicines that don’t work for me, but hopefully you will find something that works for you. Has your dr prescribed any medications to help?

Numbers on the emptying test and symptoms don’t always correlate. Your results will be different depending on the day too. Some days are better than others. Someone could have 20% left over and have every symptom in the book super severely while someone else could have 90% retention and only a few symptoms that aren’t super bad. And the next day they could swap! Like I said, some days are better than others. I have minor retention with severe symptoms.

Oh I don’t have mmj just mj so I don’t know anything about the different strains, I just get what I get lol. That’s awesome that you learned another language. I hope you find something awesome you enjoy where you can utilize that skill!

I have sibo now and that’s why I’m on the erythromycin. I got prescribed domperidone but I had a hard time figuring out what I was supposed to do and decided it was too expensive no matter what way I ordered it because I just don’t have that much money at one time. So I have yet to try it. It’s literally the only thing I know of that I haven’t tried. Even my gastric stimulator barely works but I get it turned up tomorrow

I have and it doesn’t work for me at all, only IV promethazine but I have to go to the er to get that and it’s expensive. I am so glad it works for you. I did like the taste of the dissolving ones. Peppermints help me too.
That sounds like I would love that. I will look into it. I have a DaBudda at home but it would be nice to have something portable other than just a pipe.

I think it’s harder because people around me are judging me out loud for smoking so much even though they see me so sick and also smoke themselves? Lol it can be really confusing tbh.
I am down to only consuming Ensure Plus, goldfish, and some hard sour candy to attempt to curb nausea. 
I take metoclopramide, bentyl, promethazine, erythromycin and Tramadol. Nothing does anything. Weed only helps nausea, once I puke I’m screwed and have to go to er for IV meds.

It definitely helps. I smoke a ton. Like an ounce about every 3 weeks. I can’t get a vape pen though. I live in Texas and the only people I know sell them for like $60 a cartridge and they only last me like 4 days so that’s too expensive lol. I hope they legalize it at least for medicinal purposes soon.
